plugins.name: git-kit
plugins.description: Git and GitHub workflow toolkit: commit and PR creation, GitHub CLI operations, git worktrees, notes, bisect, branch cleanup, rebase syncing, commit-shaping guidance, PR review summaries, issue drafting, dependency updates, gated PR merging, and CODEOWNERS management.
